description: Inserts an empty rows x columns table at an index, or at the end of the body when index is omitted. Fill the cells afterwards: read_document_text shows the new table's range and per-cell layout, then insert_text into each cell (cell content ranges are visible in get_document; each cell holds its own paragraphs). Cell merging, cell background/borders and pinned header rows are not covered by typed tools — use raw_request with mergeTableCells/updateTableCellStyle/pinTableHeaderRows.

columns.description: Number of columns (the API caps width).

document_id.description: The document id — the long id from the document URL (docs.google.com/document/d/<documentId>/edit) or from create_document output.

index.description: Insertion index (from read_document_text). Omit to append at the end.

segment_id.description: Header/footer/footnote segment id (from get_document). Omit for the document body.

tab_id.description: Tab to target (from list_tabs). Omit for the first/only tab.

name: insert_table
title: Insert a table
